mapper.select: select pk, biz_module, biz_data_id, action, auth_str, auth_desc from demo_auth_data where biz_module = #{bizModule} order by pk

select 'demo_auth_data' as table_name, count(*) as row_count from demo_auth_data union all select 'demo_user_auth', count(*) from demo_user_auth union all select 'demo_menu_auth', count(*) from demo_menu_auth union all select 'demo_menu_api', count(*) from demo_menu_api union all select 'demo_work_order', count(*) from demo_work_order union all select 'demo_asset', count(*) from demo_asset union all select 'demo_customer', count(*) from demo_customer union all select 'demo_execution_log', count(*) from demo_execution_log
